points.title: 童年与早期教育
points.description: 列宁出生于辛比尔斯克的一个中产阶级家庭，父亲是国民教育监察官，母亲是教师。原名弗拉基米尔·伊里奇·乌里扬诺夫。1878年进入辛比尔斯克古典中学学习，1887年因哥哥亚历山大参与刺杀沙皇亚历山大三世被捕处决，这对年轻的列宁产生了深远影响，促使他转向革命道路。这一时期，他接触了车尔尼雪夫斯基等革命民主主义者的著作，开始形成自己的政治观点。
points.descriptionEn: Born in Simbirsk to a middle-class family, Vladimir Ulyanov (later Lenin) had a father who was a school inspector and a mother who was a teacher. He entered Simbirsk Classical Gymnasium in 1878 and in 1887, his elder brother Alexander was executed for participating in an assassination attempt on Tsar Alexander III. This event profoundly influenced the young Lenin, pushing him toward revolutionary paths. During this period, he became acquainted with the works of revolutionary democrats like Chernyshevsky, beginning to form his political views.

points.title: 革命启蒙与组织
points.description: 1891年列宁进入圣彼得堡大学法律系学习，但很快因参与学生运动被开除。他转向自学马克思主义，深入研究马克思和恩格斯的著作。1893年移居圣彼得堡后，他开始接触工人运动，组织马克思主义小组。1895年，他将多个马克思主义小组联合起来，成立了'工人阶级解放斗争协会'，这是俄国第一个马克思主义组织。同年12月，列宁被捕并被流放到西伯利亚，为期三年。这一时期，他完成了《俄国资本主义的发展》等重要著作，奠定了其作为马克思主义理论家的地位。
points.descriptionEn: In 1891, Lenin entered the law faculty of Saint Petersburg University but was soon expelled for participating in student movements. He turned to self-study of Marxism, deeply researching the works of Marx and Engels. After moving to Saint Petersburg in 1893, he began engaging with the workers' movement and organizing Marxist study groups. In 1895, he united several Marxist groups to form the 'League of Struggle for the Emancipation of the Working Class,' Russia's first Marxist organization. In December of the same year, Lenin was arrested and exiled to Siberia for three years. During this period, he completed important works like 'The Development of Capitalism in Russia,' establishing his position as a Marxist theorist.

points.title: 革命理论与宣传
points.description: 1900年列宁结束流亡后，前往欧洲各国流亡，主要在瑞士、德国、法国和英国活动。他与普列汉诺夫等人共同创办了《火星报》，这份报纸成为俄国社会民主工党的宣传阵地。1903年，在党的第二次代表大会上，列宁与孟什维克派发生分歧，形成了布尔什维克派，主张建立由职业革命家组成的集中制政党。1905年俄国革命爆发后，列宁迅速回国，但革命失败后再次流亡。这一时期，他完成了《怎么办？》等重要著作，系统阐述了无产阶级政党的理论和策略，为十月革命奠定了理论基础。
points.descriptionEn: After ending his exile in 1900, Lenin traveled across Europe, mainly residing in Switzerland, Germany, France, and Britain. He co-founded the newspaper 'Iskra' with Plekhanov and others, which became the propaganda organ of the Russian Social Democratic Labour Party. In 1903, at the party's Second Congress, Lenin had a split with the Menshevik faction, forming the Bolshevik faction that advocated for a centralized party of professional revolutionaries. When the 1905 Russian Revolution broke out, Lenin returned to Russia but went into exile again after the revolution failed. During this period, he completed important works like 'What Is to Be Done?', systematically expounding the theory and strategy of the proletarian party, laying the theoretical foundation for the October Revolution.

points.title: 十月革命胜利
points.description: 1917年二月革命推翻沙皇统治后，列宁于4月从瑞士返回彼得格勒。他提出了著名的《四月提纲》，主张将资产阶级民主革命转变为社会主义革命，全部政权归苏维埃。7月，列宁因临时政府的通缉被迫转入地下。在布尔什维克党的领导下，列宁制定了武装起义的计划。10月24日，列宁领导布尔什维克发动了十月武装起义，推翻了临时政府，建立了世界上第一个社会主义国家——苏维埃俄国。11月，列宁当选为苏维埃政府人民委员会主席，成为新国家的领导人。这一时期，他颁布了《和平法令》和《土地法令》，宣布退出第一次世界大战，将土地分配给农民。
points.descriptionEn: After the February Revolution of 1917 overthrew the tsarist regime, Lenin returned to Petrograd in April from Switzerland. He presented his famous 'April Theses,' advocating the transformation of the bourgeois democratic revolution into a socialist revolution with all power to the soviets. In July, Lenin was forced to go underground due to the Provisional Government's arrest warrant. Under the leadership of the Bolshevik Party, Lenin formulated plans for an armed uprising. On October 24, Lenin led the Bolsheviks to launch the October armed uprising, overthrowing the Provisional Government and establishing the world's first socialist state—Soviet Russia. In November, Lenin was elected Chairman of the Council of People's Commissars, becoming the leader of the new state. During this period, he issued the 'Decree on Peace' and 'Decree on Land,' announcing Russia's withdrawal from World War I and distributing land to peasants.

points.title: 巩固苏维埃政权
points.description: 1918年3月，列宁将苏维埃政府从彼得格勒迁至莫斯科，以躲避德军进攻并便于管理国家。这一时期，苏维埃政权面临内外交困：国内白军叛乱、外国武装干涉，经济崩溃，饥荒严重。列宁实施了战时共产主义政策，将工业、银行和运输业收归国有，实行粮食垄断，以集中资源应对战争。1921年，面对严重的经济危机和农民起义，列宁转而实行新经济政策(NEP)，允许一定程度的市场经济和私人贸易，以恢复国民经济。这一时期，列宁还领导了与德国的《布列斯特-立托夫斯克和约》谈判，虽然割让了大量领土，但使俄国退出了第一次世界大战，为巩固苏维埃政权争取了时间。
points.descriptionEn: In March 1918, Lenin moved the Soviet government from Petrograd to Moscow to escape German advances and better manage the state. During this period, the Soviet regime faced internal and external crises: White Army rebellions, foreign military intervention, economic collapse, and severe famine. Lenin implemented the War Communism policy, nationalizing industry, banks, and transportation, and implementing grain monopolies to concentrate resources for the war effort. By 1921, facing severe economic crisis and peasant uprisings, Lenin shifted to the New Economic Policy (NEP), allowing a degree of market economy and private trade to restore the national economy. During this period, Lenin also led the negotiation of the Treaty of Brest-Litovsk with Germany, which, despite ceding large territories, withdrew Russia from World War I and bought time for consolidating Soviet power.

points.title: 晚年与遗产
points.description: 1922年起，列宁的健康状况急剧恶化，多次中风。尽管如此，他仍继续参与国家事务，口授了《给代表大会的信》等重要文件，对党和国家领导人提出了批评和建议。1923年，他提出了合作社计划，希望通过合作社引导农民走向社会主义。1924年1月21日，列宁在莫斯科高尔基村逝世，享年53岁。列宁的去世引发了党内权力斗争，最终斯大林上台。列宁的思想和实践对20世纪世界历史产生了深远影响，他创立的布尔什维克党成为许多国家共产党的榜样，他关于帝国主义的理论、殖民地解放运动的思想以及建设社会主义的实践，影响了全球范围内的革命运动。他的遗体被永久保存在莫斯科红场的列宁墓中，成为苏联和后来的俄罗斯的重要象征。
points.descriptionEn: From 1922 onwards, Lenin's health deteriorated rapidly, with multiple strokes. Despite this, he continued to participate in state affairs, dictating important documents like 'Letter to the Congress,' in which he criticized and suggested improvements for party and state leaders. In 1923, he proposed the cooperative plan, hoping to guide peasants toward socialism through cooperatives. On January 21, 1924, Lenin died in Gorki, Moscow, at the age of 53. Lenin's death triggered an internal power struggle within the party, ultimately leading to Stalin's rise to power. Lenin's ideas and practices had a profound impact on 20th-century world history. The Bolshevik Party he founded became a model for communist parties in many countries. His theories on imperialism, thoughts on colonial liberation movements, and practices of building socialism influenced revolutionary movements worldwide. His body was permanently preserved in Lenin's Mausoleum on Red Square in Moscow, becoming an important symbol of the Soviet Union and later Russia.

supporter.zh: 列宁被支持者视为伟大的革命导师和马克思主义理论家，他领导十月革命建立了世界上第一个社会主义国家，开创了人类历史的新纪元。他提出的帝国主义理论、殖民地解放思想以及建设社会主义的实践，为世界被压迫民族和人民提供了思想武器和行动指南。列宁强调无产阶级政党的先锋队作用，强调理论与实践相结合，这些思想至今仍对国际共产主义运动产生深远影响。支持者认为，列宁的思想和实践代表了人类追求社会进步和解放的最高成就。
supporter.en: Supporters view Lenin as a great revolutionary leader and Marxist theorist who led the October Revolution to establish the world's first socialist state, opening a new era in human history. His theories on imperialism, thoughts on colonial liberation, and practices of building socialism provided ideological weapons and practical guidance for oppressed nations and peoples worldwide. Lenin emphasized the vanguard role of the proletarian party and the integration of theory with practice, ideas that continue to profoundly influence the international communist movement. Supporters believe that Lenin's ideas and practices represent the highest achievements in humanity's pursuit of social progress and liberation.

critic.zh: 批评者认为列宁建立的极权体制导致了大规模的人权侵犯和政治镇压。他的红色恐怖政策处决了数以万计的反对者，建立的秘密警察机构契卡成为后来克格勃的前身。列宁的战时共产主义政策引发了严重的经济危机和饥荒，导致数百万人死亡。批评者还指出，列宁的民主集中制原则实际上导致了党内独裁，为斯大林的大清洗铺平了道路。此外，列宁对农民的强制征粮政策和压制不同意见的做法，被视为违背了社会主义的初衷，建立了与马克思理想相悖的专制政权。
critic.en: Critics argue that the totalitarian system established by Lenin led to massive human rights violations and political repression. His Red Terror policy executed tens of thousands of opponents, and his secret police agency, the Cheka, became the predecessor of the KGB. Lenin's War Communism policy triggered severe economic crises and famine, causing millions of deaths. Critics also point out that Lenin's principle of democratic centralism actually led to intra-party dictatorship, paving the way for Stalin's Great Purge. Furthermore, Lenin's forced grain requisitioning from peasants and suppression of dissent are seen as betraying the original ideals of socialism and establishing a dictatorship contrary to Marx's vision.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，列宁被视为20世纪最具影响力的政治人物之一。他的形象经历了从苏联时期的神化到后苏联时期的复杂评价。历史学者普遍承认列宁对世界格局的深远影响，同时也客观分析其政策的历史背景和后果。在流行文化中，列宁的形象既有严肃的历史纪录片，也有艺术化的表现。他的思想和实践成为研究20世纪政治、经济和社会变革的重要案例。当代学术界对列宁的研究更加多元化和批判性，既关注他的革命理论和实践，也探讨其思想的历史局限性和对后世的影响。
objective.en: In historical scholarship and popular culture, Lenin is regarded as one of the most influential political figures of the 20th century. His image has evolved from deification during the Soviet period to more complex evaluations in the post-Soviet era. Historians generally acknowledge Lenin's profound impact on the global landscape while objectively analyzing the historical context and consequences of his policies. In popular culture, Lenin's image appears in both serious historical documentaries and artistic representations. His ideas and practices have become important case studies for examining 20th-century political, economic, and social transformations. Contemporary academic research on Lenin is more diverse and critical, examining both his revolutionary theories and practices as well as the historical limitations of his thought and their impact on later generations.

self.zh: 社会主义就是从国家资本主义垄断向前迈进一步的大同社会。
self.en: Socialism is merely the next step forward from state-capitalist monopoly.

others.zh: 列宁是历史上最伟大的实践家之一，他不仅改变了俄罗斯的命运，也改变了整个世界的进程。
others.en: Lenin was one of the greatest practical statesmen in history; he changed not only the destiny of Russia but the course of the entire world.
